ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels dominate approximately 80-85% of the visible surface, contrasted sharply by low-intensity black/dark-gray pigmentation along the trailing edge and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the trailing edge (continuous band), a vertical series of three horizontally-oriented dark blobs at the central base (peduncle area), and one isolated elliptical dark spot on the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees, extending inward toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration with peak amplitudes of 5-15 pixels. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced, jagged peaks compared to the left lobe, which shows more consistent, smaller-scale oscillations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves on both the left and right lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A small cluster of low-intensity pixel clusters is visible at the extreme far-left tip; minor dark focal points are scattered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark linear pixel disruptions are visible diagonally on the right lobe surface and horizontally near the central lower region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge shows significant irregular topography and minor tissue indentations, suggesting environmental wear or previous minor mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertically-stacked arrangement of three dark horizontal dash-like markings situated directly above the water line at the central axis.
